purpose: Frozen cross-domain test of metadata-only exclusive-allocation derivation repair.

cases.source: There is one dose of medicine and it cannot be divided.
Only one lifeboat seat remains for Alice or Ben.
One donor organ is available and only one patient can receive it.
Exactly one oxygen tank remains for diver A or diver B.
A single scholarship can be awarded to applicant A or applicant B, but not both.
Two medicine doses are available, enough for both patients.
One water supply is available and can be divided between both shelters.
One oxygen tank is here, but another tank is available from the nearby station.
Give Lee a scholarship; the allocation is not exhaustive and other awards may exist.
Several lifeboat seats remain, and multiple passengers may board.
